title: Gift Wrap Roll

adjustment.analysis: Baseline median is 3.0. No events, promotions, or price changes this week. Recent weeks show no trend or seasonal ramp. Past promotions had weak noise-adjusted effects (x1.0), and post-promotion weeks show no lasting dip. Mother's Day (May 4) and Easter (Mar 30) were above baseline but not significantly so. Memorial Day (May 25) had low sales. The classical model suggests no lift, consistent with noise-adjusted evidence. No driver justifies a multiplier away from 1.0.
